sql: SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel') AS channel, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.EventId') AS event_id FROM unified_events WHERE case_id = ? AND artifact_id = 'evtx' AND lower(json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Channel')) LIKE '%powershell%' AND (lower(payload_json) LIKE '%invoke-webrequest%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%invoke-restmethod%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%resolve-dnsname%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%gethostaddresses%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%net.webclient%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%downloadstring%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%downloaddata%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%start-bitstransfer%') AND (lower(payload_json) LIKE '%.test/%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%.test''%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%.test\"%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%.invalid%' OR lower(payload_json) LIKE '%.example/%')
